description: This file defines the LeavePeriod class within the OrangeHRM Leave module. It encapsulates a date range with start and end dates, providing methods to access and modify these dates, and involves date formatting via a trait.

classes.name: LeavePeriod
classes.description: Represents a period of leave with optional start and end dates, providing getters and setters, as well as formatted date strings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize leave period with optional start and end DateTime objects.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the leave period.

methods.name: getYmdStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date formatted as a 'Y-m-d' string using the date helper.

methods.name: setStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the leave period.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the leave period.

methods.name: getYmdEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date formatted as a 'Y-m-d' string using the date helper.

methods.name: setEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the leave period.
